candidate.definition_en: A sum of money paid regularly by a company to its shareholders out of its profits.
candidate.explanation_ar: جزء من أرباح الشركة بيتوزع على المساهمين كل فترة، أو الفايدة اللي بتعود عليك من حاجة عملتها.

senses.definition_en: A sum of money paid regularly by a company to its shareholders out of its profits.
senses.definition_ar: حصة من أرباح الشركة توزع بانتظام على المساهمين.

examples: The board declared a quarterly dividend of 50 cents.
The annual dividend was increased after a profitable year.
The company decided not to pay a dividend to its shareholders this year.
candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Divide' 'يقسم'.. الأرباح اللي بتتقسم على الناس.
